_about: Public-domain Frederic A. Noble, pastor of the Union Park Congregational Church, Chicago, for the Word Hoard: Discourses on the Epistle to the Philippians, Typical New Testament Conversions, The Pilgrims, Spiritual Culture, an address on Abraham Lincoln, and occasional sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 125 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
